core.title: Polished Brass Rim Cylinder Lock, Schlage 20-022C-605

text.description_html:
Schlage Polished Brass Rim Cylinder Lock

Commercial door rim cylinder lock. Rim cylinders are normally used on the doors exterior to unlatch Panic Devices. Polished Brass finish.

Specifications: for Schlage 20-022-C-605 Polished Brass Rim Cylinder

  • Keyed Rim cylinder
  • Key Cylinder 6-pin Schlage "C" Keyway
  • Flat "cut to size" tail piece
  • Packed with separate collar ring
  • Includes mounting plate and 2 screws
